Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere.
Matched everyday objects to 3D shapes.
Identified a ball as a sphere, a box as a cube, and a lunchbox as a cuboid.
Explained that a cylinder has curved sides and two circular ends.
Teach-back was not completed; no misconceptions recorded.
end.parentNote: Asha practised 3D-shape names and matching shapes to everyday objects. Ishita used shape features such as equal square faces, curved sides, and circular ends to explain several answers. They repeatedly asked for real photos, drawings, a game, and Peppa Pig; these requests were not part of the lesson activity. At home, ask them to find one object for each shape and describe one feature aloud.
